claims.claim: For every v in the current suffix subspace of a hidden-affine triangular bijection, 1 xor C(x,x+v) is the first hidden output coordinate changed by v, as a function of x, at every total degree d.
claims.scope: Exact strict lexicographic comparison; q_i=u_i+g_i(u_<i), u affine invertible over F2; finite total-degree upper bound d.
claims.limitations: Requires the complete hidden-affine triangular promise; a partial flag with an arbitrary suffix does not imply this identity.

claims.claim: Fresh matching labels plus one priority comparison select the earliest candidate direction; winner-only degree-d ANF interpolation and the response row q(v)+q(0) recover the next coordinate and exact next suffix kernel.
claims.scope: All degree bounds d under the complete hidden-affine triangular promise; no polar form is used in the update.
claims.limitations: The theorem assumes independent fresh uniform global points for matching and a correct exact comparison oracle.

claims.claim: The independent comparator-only implementation recovered all coordinate polynomials and had zero rank or inverse errors on 33 seeded degree-3/4 hidden-affine triangular cases through n=9; prefix projection was exhaustively checked through n=8.
claims.scope: 18 degree-3 cases n=4..9 and 15 degree-4 cases n=5..9, three seeds per (degree,n); all 2^n inputs checked per case.
claims.limitations: Seeded finite tests do not establish the random cutoff guarantee, asymptotic behavior, practical superiority, or novelty.

claims.claim: The known-input-basis triangular subclass contains 2^L distinct orders for L=sum_h binom(n,h+1); a capped randomized comparison learner with per-order success at least 1-beta needs Q>=L+log2(1-beta), and an expected-query learner has the stated Fano lower bound.
claims.scope: One-bit exact comparison oracle; 0<=beta<=1/2; UNKNOWN counts as failure.
claims.limitations: The lower bound is for the fixed-known-affine-coordinate subclass and comparisons only; it does not charge source-side computation or establish optimality beyond that class.

claims.claim: Uncapped expected comparisons are at most n*M_d+5*binom(n,2); a cap T=ceil(log2(binomial(n,2)/beta)) gives UNKNOWN probability at most beta and worst-case comparisons n*M_d+(2T+1)*binom(n,2).
claims.scope: Fixed complete triangular class, exact comparator, fresh independent global random points; P=0 handled separately.
claims.limitations: For fixed degree d>=2 and fixed beta, the leading expected comparison ratio to L is d+1; for d=1 the capped worst-case bound has an additional logarithm.

claims.claim: The source-side dense teacher cost is separated from learner comparisons: its concrete n-bit mask evaluator is conservatively charged O(n^2+nL) elementary bitwork per distinct rank input, plus O(n) per comparison for rank comparison; the scalar-gate mathematical evaluator has O(n^2+dL) cost.
claims.scope: Dense triangular ANF representation with L coefficients and affine input transform; U distinct endpoints across Q comparisons.
claims.limitations: Python runtime measurements, memory overhead, cache locality, and any external comparator implementation are not measured by this asymptotic model.

claims.claim: This degree-3/4 audit establishes neither novelty nor practical advantage, external proof review, physical validation, or the broader mission.
claims.scope: Current independent mathematical and finite-computational evidence only.
claims.limitations: The prior-art and physical-interface gates remain open.
